extraction_notes: Multi-variant datasheet covering ES1A through ES1M (Zhuhai Hongjiacheng Technology co., Ltd, www.ichjc.com); ES1D column values used: VRRM=200V, VRMS=140V, VDC=200V (page 1).

Key maximum ratings (page 1): IF(AV)=1.0A at 60Hz sinewave resistance load per Fig.1, IFSM=30.0A at t=8.3ms half-sine wave, Tstg=-55 to +150degC, Tj=-55 to +150degC, typical RthJA=80degC/W and RthJL=35degC/W. Package DO-214AC(SMA), cathode line denotes cathode end.
VF table entry 1.0V max at IF=1.0A spans the ES1A-ES1D columns; ES1F-ES1G is 1.3V and ES1H-ES1M is 1.7V (page 2). Fig.3 solid curve is likewise the ES1A-ES1D group curve and applies to ES1D.
Second reverse leakage spec not representable in the single reverse_current slot: IR2=200uA maximum at VR=VDC, Ta=125degC (page 2).
Reverse recovery: Trr=35ns maximum at IF=0.5A, IR=1.0A, Irr=0.25A (page 2); fast recovery rectifier.

No explicit breakdown voltage or breakdown test current is specified; Fig.4 (typical reverse characteristics) shows a sharp avalanche knee at approximately 125-127% of rated VRRM (about 250-254V for ES1D), but this is a typical percent-of-rated curve, not a guaranteed spec, so breakdown fields are null.

Curves digitized from a 400 dpi rasterization of page 2 with pixel-anchored gridline calibration (automated column scans of the curve strokes, gridline rows/columns excluded). Fig.3 values at 1.0V and 1.4V and the VF points at 1A/5A/10A are log-interpolated between adjacent sampled columns; reading uncertainty approximately +/-0.01V on Fig.3 voltages, +/-0.5A on Fig.2 currents, and roughly +/-5% on log-axis current values.

Fig.4 reverse-current curves apply family-wide as percent of rated VRRM; to convert to absolute volts for ES1D multiply x-values by 2 (100% = 200V). The near-vertical breakdown region above about 123% (25degC) / 120% (125degC) was not digitized because x-resolution there is unreliable.

Fig.2 surge curve is family-wide (single curve for all variants), 8.3ms single half sine wave, JEDEC method; the curve near 100 cycles (approximately 5.5-6A) was too close to the plot frame for a reliable automated read and was omitted.
